title: Check yourself: Failures, conflicts, the coverage note and the practice

questions.stem: Under the module's bounded policy for failures, a search subagent times out and its error offers an alternative query. What should the coordinator do?

options.text: Retry the same query until it succeeds, however many attempts that takes in total
options.says: Ruled out because the retry is bounded: "The coordinator retries once through an alternative and then stops."

options.text: Retry with the suggested substitute once, then report the scope as not covered
options.says: One retry through the alternative, then an honest gap.

options.text: Stop the whole run and return the error to the caller, who will decide
options.says: Ruled out because one failed scope does not end the run: "A failure of one subagent does not end the run: the other scopes are still worth reporting."

options.text: Mark the scope as covered and let the synthesis agent fill the gap
options.says: Ruled out because a scope without findings is not covered: "A scope that is marked covered without findings is a claim that nothing supports."

origin.section: A failure is a result with context

questions.stem: Two publications report 12 and 14 for the same statistic, a year apart. How should the report treat them?

options.text: Report the value that more of the other documents seem to support, whichever it is
options.says: Ruled out because the report does not settle a conflict by a vote of other documents: "a vote of sources is not evidence about the statistic, so both values stay".

options.text: Report the newer value alone, since a more recent figure replaces an older one
options.says: Ruled out because the newer value is not picked in silence: "A conflict is two different values for one claim, not two sources for the same value".

options.text: Report the average of the two figures, since each is probably close to the truth
options.says: Ruled out because the values are not blended: "the report does not average them and does not pick the newer one in silence".

options.text: Show both values with their sources and dates, and give neither as the answer
options.says: A conflict is shown with both values, both sources and both dates.

origin.section: Conflicts, and why the dates matter

questions.stem: A search failed after it had already returned two usable results for its topic. How should the report record that topic?

options.text: As covered, because some usable results were returned for it
options.says: Ruled out because partial is not coverage: "A partial result is information, and it is not coverage".

options.text: As uncovered, keeping what arrived but marking it incomplete
options.says: Partial findings are kept and flagged, and the topic is still a gap.

options.text: As covered once the synthesis agent has accepted the results
options.says: Ruled out because acceptance is not the test: "coverage is a property of the question and not of what happened to arrive".

options.text: As missing, with the two results dropped so that they cannot mislead
options.says: Ruled out because the findings are worth keeping: "Partial findings stay in the claims, flagged, so a reader can use them and can see that they are incomplete."

origin.section: Partial is information and it is not coverage
